name: Architectural System Fabricators
old_description: Yes. Custom fabrication is at the core of what we do. We work closely with architects, contractors, and construction firms to fabricate metal components to exact specifications. Whether you provide your own drawings or need design support, our team is equipped to deliver precision-crafted solutions.
about:
Architectural System Fabricators LLC operates from a facility on Industrial Drive in Southington, Connecticut. The company was founded in 2019 by Adam, who grew up in construction working alongside his father before expanding into commercial metalwork and investing in advanced machinery for his own projects. Recognizing a gap in the market for reliable, high-quality architectural metal fabrication, he established ASF to focus on precision, speed, and customer collaboration.

The shop specializes exclusively in architectural metalwork — not general steel fabrication — producing custom ACM panels, brake-formed components, CNC-routed designs, and long-folded profiles up to 20 feet. Core processes include brake forming, CNC routing, laser cutting, punching, in-house coil processing, welding, folding, shearing, and both liquid and powder coating. Equipment highlights include Connecticut's only long-folding machine, advanced CNC routers, and high-precision laser cutters. The team brings over 55 years of combined architectural metal fabrication experience.

ASF serves architects, contractors, and construction firms on commercial, institutional, and industrial projects across the United States, with a regional focus on Fairfield County, southern Connecticut, and New England. Past work includes ACM panels and brake-formed trim for the Greenwich Residence, aluminum soffit panels for the Plainville School, and 100,000 square feet of custom louver blades for a single project. The company also fabricated components for the CJ Huang Recreation Center and has worked with Laminators Inc.

The company differentiates itself through its architectural-only focus, in-house coil processing, and the long-folding capability unique in Connecticut. It emphasizes design support, turning concepts into fabrication-ready drawings, and nationwide shipping with secure crating from single pallets to full truckloads.
